title: Strategic and Robust Task Allocation for Combat Objectives in Adversarial Multi-Agent Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.34158v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Task allocation in contested-objective team games requires coordinated decisions under uncertainty, spatial constraints, and changing tactical conditions. In such settings, multiple agents must anticipate both teammate behavior and opponent actions. We study a hybrid predict-then-optimize approach for assigning controllable agents to objectives in real time. A masked multi-head model predicts tactical signals for each agent, including survival chance, local superiority, combat interaction, travel time, and objective contribution. These signals are combined with rule-based terms in a score matrix, and a minimum-cost flow solver computes coordinated global assignments constrained by capacity, occupancy, stability, and defensive strategies. Learning is limited to tactical scoring, while explicit rules and solver structure preserve controllability and interpretability. translated_title: 对抗性多智能体环境中面向作战目标的策略性与鲁棒任务分配
translated_abstract: 在争夺目标点的团队博弈中，任务分配需要在不确定性、空间约束和不断变化的战术条件下进行协调决策。在这类场景中，多个智能体必须同时预判队友的行为和对手的行动。我们研究了一种“先预测后优化”的混合方法，用于实时地将可控智能体分配到各个目标。一个带掩码的多头模型为每个智能体预测战术信号，包括生存概率、局部优势、战斗交互、行进时间和目标贡献度。这些信号与基于规则的项组合成评分矩阵，并由最小费用流求解器在容量、占据状态、稳定性和防御策略等约束下计算协调的全局分配方案。学习仅限于战术评分部分，而显式规则和求解器结构保证了系统的可控性与可解释性。我们使用预测指标、离线分配诊断等方法对系统进行评估。
tldr: 本文提出一种“先预测后优化”的混合任务分配方法，通过多头模型预测战术信号并结合最小费用流求解器，在对抗性多智能体环境中实现实时、可控、可解释且鲁棒的作战目标分配。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid predict-then-optimize task allocation method that combines a masked multi-head tactical prediction model with a minimum-cost flow solver to achieve real-time, controllable, interpretable, and robust assignment of agents to combat objectives in adversarial multi-agent environments.
